description: This Kotlin source file implements a mock repository for recipes, providing in-memory data for testing or development purposes. It defines the class MockRecipeRepository which implements the RecipeRepository interface, managing a list of recipes with functions to retrieve, filter, and toggle favorite status.

classes.name: MockRecipeRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of the RecipeRepository interface that provides in-memory recipe data for testing purposes.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting the list of all recipes.

methods.name: getRecipesByCuisine
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting recipes filtered by the specified cuisine.

methods.name: getFavoriteRecipes
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting recipes marked as favorite.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Suspending function that retrieves a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Suspending function that toggles the favorite status of a recipe by its ID.

methods.name: getAvailableCuisines
methods.description: Returns a list of available cuisine types.

methods.name: createMockRecipes
methods.description: Private function that creates and returns a list of mock recipes for demonstration.
